description: Implement factorial(n) in solution.py. Return n! for n >= 0. For n=0 return 1.
Implement is_palindrome(s) in solution.py. Return True if string s reads the same forwards and backwards (ignore case).
Implement sum_list(nums) in solution.py. Return the sum of all numbers in the list.
Implement reverse_string(s) in solution.py. Return the reversed string.
Implement fibonacci(n) in solution.py. Return the n-th Fibonacci number (0-indexed: fib(0)=0, fib(1)=1).
Implement max_in_list(nums) in solution.py. Return the maximum value in the list. Raise ValueError on empty list.
Implement count_vowels(s) in solution.py. Return the count of vowels (a,e,i,o,u) in s, case-insensitive.
Implement is_prime(n) in solution.py. Return True if n is prime, False otherwise. n >= 2 for primes; 0 and 1 are not prime.

Implement a function called 'calculator(a, op, b)' in solution.py. It takes two numbers and a string operator ('+', '-', '*', '/'). Return the result. Raise ValueError if op is unknown. Raise ZeroDivisionError if dividing by zero.
Fix the bug in solution.py. The function 'binary_search(arr, target)' should return the index of target in a sorted list, or -1 if not found. The current implementation has a bug.
